items.hed: Fairbairn's 49-yard kick beat Jacksonville 34-31 in London
items.insight: The Houston Texans said Ka'imi Fairbairn hit a 49-yard field goal to finish a seven-play, 36-yard drive and lift Houston past Jacksonville 34-31 at Wembley. He was 2-for-2 on field goals and 4-for-4 on extra points. Safety Calen Bullock had five tackles, two passes defensed, and his first interception of the season. The club said the win moved the all-time series to 33-16 and left Houston 2-0 against the Jaguars in London.

items.hed: Astros season ended in a Wild Card sweep at home
items.insight: MLB.com reported that Chicago beat Houston 7-3 on Sept. 30 and swept the American League Wild Card Series at Daikin Park. Houston had won the West on the last day of the regular season, then became the first team out. The club finished 81-81. It was the ninth straight home postseason loss, and the second Wild Card sweep in three years.
